proof.strongBand: h*ell/t=h*ell^(3/4)>=512/sqrt(h)>512*2^2048. The displayed exact integer inequality therefore gives h*ell/200000>16*power*t+bits*t.
proof.dyadic: 2*power*log2(ell)<16*power*t and t>1. Subtract these exponents without rounding epsilon or h to zero.
proof.radial: Lambda^2>Tg follows from 14>9sqrt(2), checked by196>162. Thus1/2<rho<1 and1<dr<17/8<3.

derivation.band: The literal common recursion contains log b1 >= (ellMinimum+10)*log2. Hence ellA=ceil(log2(4b1))>=ellMinimum+12, S>=B^1024 and ellA>=(64/h)^2. This is this common band, not the earlier terminal numerical band.
derivation.base: B>=2^128 and B>=Renv^4096. The original source radius and reciprocal are<Renv<B. This follows from the actual annulus geometry Xa<=X<=Xb and the retained Xb<CSelected^11 bound, also used by the private direction ledger.
derivation.growth: Renv^-31<lambda0<Renv^83, u=2Renv^10 and2<=u<B imply B^-1<g=3lambda0*u^2/(1+u^2)^(3/2)<B. Therefore g*Ls>B^1022.
derivation.cone: The actual moving-frame and damping errors are at most B^256/S. The SAME invariant cone gives w_plus>0 and |w_minus/w_plus|<=B^260/S<=B^-764.
derivation.absoluteCenter: The same band has k>S^8. The actual rounded b=b0+delta_b satisfies |delta_b|<=B^2/S^8 because Rchart>Renv^-1 and Bs>Renv^-40. Every generic adiabatic remainder is uniform in the new terminal midplane representative.

derivation.bump: Every normalized radial bump lies below 4. Its physical X endpoint is below 16*X0Ipos < exp(5)*X0Ipos.
derivation.wait: lambda>h>0 makes Qsteep>0. Qb>(1/3)*(1/2)*4*2048>1, while 0<Qp<27*h/255<h<1. Thus log(Qb/Qp)/(1-h)>0.
derivation.final: Immediately after the pulse lies an interval of length Tf=128, followed by positive stage lengths. Thus Xplus<Xv*exp(128)<Xb.

proof.actualMap: The original nearest lift, original physical Yi, original slow chart, chosen box, and original angular carrier are all bound above. Xi=0 and v=Ls/2 result from exact inverse equations, not an arbitrary assignment of auxiliary coordinates.
proof.fullCurl: For C=eta_beta*sqrt(epsilon)*sqrt(y)*chi*psi*(n cross t)/(k*|n|^2), the real potential is -C*sin(kPhi). Its complete cylindrical curl has the retained coefficientCurl term and exact cosine principal part. The proved Phi=0 makes only the VALUE of the sine term zero.
proof.constraint: The original B columns obey n dot B_j=0 by the explicitly retained positive square-root relation. Thus n dot t=0 and the exact vector triple product reduces the principal value to eta_beta*sqrt(epsilon)*sqrt(y)*t.
proof.wholeLocalSum: Every different active label has disjoint enlarged auxiliary support under the same original universal palette. At this chosen center only the + label contributes to the oscillatory sum.
proof.cartesian: The exact angle and orthogonal cylindrical frame are retained. The three directed coefficient intervals are in that actual cylindrical frame; the Cartesian components above are exact rotated interval expressions, not independently rounded high-relative-precision decimals.
proof.derivatives: No derivative of the sine remainder, potential, pressure or nonlinear NS residual is discarded. This certificate encloses a value; the full derivative/residual graph remains a separate construction.

method.tail: For |x|>=64 and beta<=1, P^2*(w_plus/a)^2*(1+r)^2<=4*exp(-x^2/6). Both tails are <=24/64*exp(-64^2/6)<(24/64)*2^-682. The reference Gaussian has both tails <=2^-4096/64.

derivation.frequency: ell>=(64/h)^2 gives h*sqrt(ell)>=64. log2>1/2 and log(ell)<sqrt(ell) for ell>=8 imply log(k)>=h*ell*log2/2>16*sqrt(ell)>16*log(ell)=8*log(S), hence k>S^8. No giant integer or positive h is rounded.
derivation.scalar: Since w_plus>0, d_tau log(w_plus)=Ls*M11+Ls*M12*(w_minus/w_plus). The exact reduced diagonal differs from -(3/2)*s*sign*u/(1+s^2) by at most B^14/S; the full coupling is at most B^516/S.
derivation.damping: epsilon*k^2*Bs^2=lambda0/(1+u^2)^(3/2). Thus|Ls*(damping-dref)|<=B*Ls*(b^2+(2u+1)|sA-s|); its sign is not discarded.
derivation.reference: Aref=((1+u^2/4)/(1+u^2))^(3/4). The inner ratio is1/4+3/(4*(1+u^2)); on[1/4,1], the derivative of x^(3/4) is<3, so0<Aref-1/(2*sqrt2)<3/u^2.
derivation.exponential: For |e|<=1/2, |exp(e)-1|<=2|e|. Aref<=1, hence|a_sign-1/(2*sqrt2)|<=2*halfLog+3/u^2<2^-8192. Every remainder is strictly positive.
